hooks.text: 在岛屿上建设并升级防御塔，持续击退入侵怪潮
hooks.excerpt: An exciting tower defense game where you have to defend your island from the invasion of enemy forces. Your task is to build and upgrade towers to repel waves of attacking enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 五种防御塔各有独立特性，需要按敌情选择配置
hooks.excerpt: Five types of towers: You have access to five different types of towers for defense. Each tower has its own unique characteristics. Choose wisely to effectively deal with enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 资源必须集中投入岛屿薄弱点，让塔位覆盖最容易被突破的区域
hooks.excerpt: Your strategic thinking and ability to effectively use resources will be key in this struggle for survival. Features: - 3D Graphics - Five types of towers: You have access to five different types of towers for defense. Each tower has its own unique characteristics. Choose wisely to effectively deal with enemies. - Variety of enemies: A variety of enemies await you in the game. - Strategic thinking: Place towers so that they cover the most vulnerable points of the island and effectively restrain enemies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
